title: Hyatt’s Luxury Portfolio Builds Momentum Across the Americas
summary: CHICAGO (September 28, 2026) – As 2026 enters its final quarter, Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) is highlighting a concentrated period of growth across its luxury portfolio in the Americas,...
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO** (September 29, 2026) – As 2026 enters its final quarter, Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) is highlighting a concentrated period of growth across its luxury portfolio in the Americas, led by the expansion of the Park Hyatt portfolio in Mexico and a series of distinctive additions to The Unbound Collection by Hyatt.


From the Pacific coast of Baja California Sur to Mexico’s Caribbean coastline and the dynamic capital city of Mexico City, the Park Hyatt brand is building a three-property story across the country – with Park Hyatt Cabo del Sol which opened its doors last December and the upcoming openings of Park Hyatt Riviera Maya and Park Hyatt Mexico City Polanco. Meanwhile, properties such as The Clayfield in the heart of Niagara-on-the-Lake are expanding The Unbound Collection by Hyatt portfolio in the Americas, while the luxury all-inclusive resort Impression Isla Mujeres is set to join the collection in November. Together, these openings and brand milestones reflect Hyatt’s considered approach to luxury growth: expanding its reach while giving each brand and property a separate point of view.


*“I couldn't be more excited about our new luxury hotels – each individual, each thoughtful and gracefully designed with thought, taste and elegance. Across the Americas, our portfolio is growing with those principles in mind: from the Park Hyatt brand’s next chapter in Mexico to the Alila brand’s expansion in the Riviera Maya earlier this year, to the independent character of the beautifully individual hotels in The Unbound Collection by Hyatt. Our focus is to grow thoughtfully and give travelers more choice while ensuring each hotel has a clear point of view and highly personal service at its center.”*


– Tamara Lohan, Global Brand Leader - Luxury, Hyatt.


**Park Hyatt in Mexico: three expressions across a vibrant country**


[Park Hyatt Cabo del Sol](https://www.hyatt.com/park-hyatt/en-US/cabph-park-hyatt-cabo-del-sol?src=agn_scrpil_prop_sem_cabph_brand_bing) opened in December 2025 as the brand’s first Mexican hotel. Set on the coast of Baja California Sur, every room has views of how the property brings the Park Hyatt brand’s residential sensibility to Baja through contemporary Mexican architecture, oceanfront dining and a wellness offering shaped by the surrounding landscape.


Expected to open by the end of 2026,[Park Hyatt Riviera Maya](https://www.hyatt.com/park-hyatt/en-US/canph-park-hyatt-riviera-maya) will be the world’s first all-inclusive Park Hyatt hotel. Located on a secluded stretch of Mexico’s Caribbean coastline, the resort will offer a new interpretation of the all-inclusive experience – one shaped by choice, discretion and the art of thoughtful hosting. From personalized pre-arrival planning to entirely à la carte dining, every detail is designed to give guests the freedom to settle into Riviera Maya on their own terms.


[Park Hyatt Mexico City Polanco](https://www.hyatt.com/park-hyatt/en-US/mexph-park-hyatt-mexico-city-polanco) is expected to welcome its first guests in spring 2027. Located on Campos Elíseos in Polanco, the 155-room-and-suite hotel will overlook Chapultepec Park, with Mexican art, design and cuisine shaping its interiors and culinary offering.


Together, Cabo del Sol, Riviera Maya and Mexico City Polanco will give travelers three distinct ways to experience Mexico through the Park Hyatt lens –from the Pacific coast and Caribbean shoreline to the cultural heart of the capital. Each property will offer a sense of place shaped by its setting, allowing guests to pair a stay in Mexico City with time on either coast while enjoying the thoughtful service and considered Park Hyatt experiences.


**The Unbound Collection by Hyatt Expands with Independent Character**


Across the Americas, The Unbound Collection by Hyatt continues to grow through independent properties defined by distinctive architecture, history and service.


[The Clayfield](https://www.hyatt.com/unbound-collection/en-US/iagub-the-clayfield) , Hyatt’s new wine-country retreat in Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario, draws on the region’s clay-rich soil and surrounding vineyards for inspiration. Warm earth tones, natural materials and tactile finishes give the property a contemporary expression rooted in the character of Niagara’s wine country.


On November 2,[Impression Isla Mujeres](https://www.hyattinclusivecollection.com/en/resorts-hotels/impression-by-secrets/mexico/isla-mujeres/?src=agn|oth|corp|sem|85sixty|chico|bps|SEIIM_Trademark-Ong-ECM-USA_SEA_B_LW_EPM|bing&msclkid=5cfb1600ec8b16b6ffee7ca21ea6d1ec&utm_source=bing&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=2025_Koddi_LAC_HIC_Conversion_Mexico_SEIIM_Bing_BrandSearch_English&utm_term=secrets%20impressions%20isla%20mujeres&utm_content=Conversion_Impressions_Bing_Search_English_SEIIM_IslaMujeres_Paid_Brand_CrossDevice_1x1) will transition into The Unbound Collection by Hyatt. The adults-only, all-inclusive resort will bring its suite-led accommodations, butler service and highly personalized hospitality into a collection known for independent character and differing narratives.


This year, The Unbound Collection by Hyatt will launch an ‘experiences initiative that will celebrate rare, curated and locally rooted experiences that bring each hotel’s story and destination to life. From private culinary and wine experiences to behind-the-scenes access to local culture, artists and makers, the program is designed to create one-of-a-kind moments guests could not simply book elsewhere.[The Georgian](https://www.hyatt.com/unbound-collection/en-US/ucaab-the-georgian?src=agn_koddi_crp_chico_ppc_23669938444_Conversion_Unbound_Google_Search_English_UCAAB_SantaMonica_Paid_Brand_CrossDevice_1x1_google_Koddi-TopUp-Evergreen-Brand_e_the%20georgian&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23669938444&gclid=CjwKCAjwtp7VBhBjEiwAJfpV-1i_3_iVQM2S5fr2GfGAAxevE-JQ2ZtTZ5iaW_GVQySnav4UTHcnFRoCmNIQAvD_BwE) , **[Hotel La Compañía Casco Antiguo](https://www.hyatt.com/unbound-collection/en-US/ptyub-unbound-hotel-la-compania-casco-antiguo)** and Impression Isla Mujeres are among the properties set to offer an enriched experience program, translating design, culinary heritage, history and cultural encounters into memorable, highly personalized experiences.


**Alila Extends its Americas Story from California to Mayakoba**


The Alila portfolio in the Americas spans[Alila Ventana Big Sur](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/sjcal-ventana-big-sur) **,**[Alila Napa Valley](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/apcal-alila-napa-valley?src=agn_koddi_crp_chico_ppc_22372701500_Conversion_Alila_Google_Search_English_APCAL_StHelena_Paid_Brand_CrossDevice_1x1_google_Koddi-TopUp-Evergreen-Brand_e_alila%20napa&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=22372701500&gclid=CjwKCAjwqonVBhA4EiwA9wYJ3bbpjeaP6Qc2-qHs8A4xg88PWKxoC3sfQ6Il6O3F9jq3l26f_9h9-xoChjkQAvD_BwE) **,**[Alila Marea Beach Resort Encinitas](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/sanen-alila-marea-beach-resort-encinitas) and, since February 2026,[Alila Mayakoba](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/cunam-alila-mayakoba) .


Situated within Mayakoba on Riviera Maya, the 60-acre Alila Mayakoba resort unfolds across a stretch of beach, lagoon and jungle, with 182 guestrooms, suites and villas, six dining destinations and Alila Spa. Architecture that opens to the surrounding landscape, locally sourced materials and collaborations with regional artisans bring the Yucatán Peninsula into the design. A wellbeing program developed with local practitioners adds a cultural dimension to the stay while preserving Alila’s understated, highly personal approach.


Beginning October 1, Alila Mayakoba, **[Alila Ventana Big Sur](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/sjcal-ventana-big-sur)** , **[Alila Napa Valley](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/apcal-alila-napa-valley)** and **[Alila Marea Beach Resort Encinitas](https://www.hyatt.com/alila-hotels-and-resorts/en-US/sanen-alila-marea-beach-resort-encinitas)** will join Erewhon’s Member Lifestyle Collective, introducing the Alila brand to a highly engaged audience with a shared appreciation for wellbeing and intentional living. This fall, Erewhon members can discover more about participating Alila hotels and the Member Lifestyle Collective directly through Erewhon.


**Grand Hyatt Extends Growth Across the Americas**


Complementing the Luxury portfolio’s momentum, the Grand Hyatt brand is expanding its presence across Latin America and the Caribbean with[Grand Hyatt Grand Cayman](https://www.hyatt.com/grand-hyatt/en-US/gcmgh-grand-hyatt-grand-cayman-resort-and-spa) ,[Grand Hyatt Cancun](https://www.hyatt.com/grand-hyatt/en-US/cangh-grand-hyatt-cancun-beach-resort) and[Grand Hyatt Los Cabos](https://www.hyatt.com/grand-hyatt/en-US/sjdgh-grand-hyatt-los-cabos-resort-golf-and-spa) all set to open in the fourth quarter of 2026.


Together, these resorts extend the brand into sought-after leisure destinations, with Cancún and Los Cabos adding all-inclusive experiences to the Grand Hyatt offering in the Americas.


For more information or to book a stay, visit[hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/loyalty/en-US) .


The term “Hyatt” is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.


**About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of June 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 83 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the Luxury Portfolio, including **Park Hyatt®, Alila®, Miraval®, Impression by Secrets, and The Unbound Collection by Hyatt®** ; the Lifestyle Portfolio, including **Andaz®, Thompson Hotels®, The Standard®, Dream® Hotels, The StandardX®, Breathless Resorts & Spas®, JdV by Hyatt®, Bunkhouse® Hotels, and Me and All Hotels** ; the Inclusive Collection, including **Zoëtry® Wellness & Spa Resorts, Hyatt Ziva®, Hyatt Zilara®, Secrets® Resorts & Spas, Dreams® Resorts & Spas, Hyatt Vivid® Hotels & Resorts, Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts®, and Sunscape® Resorts & Spas** ; the Classics Portfolio, including **Grand Hyatt®, Hyatt Regency®, Destination by Hyatt®, Hyatt Centric®, Hyatt Vacation Club®, and Hyatt®** ; and the Essentials Portfolio, including **Caption by Hyatt®, Unscripted by Hyatt, Hyatt Place®, Hyatt House®, Hyatt Studios®, Hyatt Select, and UrCove** . Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit[www.hyatt.com](http://www.hyatt.com/) .
